answer: New identities are issued through a canyon queue taking one bid per second into a tide-window slot auction. In the 30-minute tide window, at most 50 applicants bid on the ledge, each posting a refundable $40 deposit for one slot, priced by the 50th bid. Before activation, the registry checks each winner's wallet against the chain graph and rejects any wallet that ever funded another identity. Forging 1,000 puppets means winning 1,000 auctions and locking $40,000 with no bulk discount, and any duplicate link forfeits that deposit; an honest applicant pays once and recovers it after one epoch.
